title: Read a grid cell
explanation:
A two-dimensional array has rows and columns.
Use grid[row][column]. Both indexes start at zero.

questions.prompt: Which expression reads 6 from the grid?
questions.code:
int grid[2][2] = {{2, 4}, {6, 8}};
int value = /* Missing line */;
questions.hint: Find the row first, then count across that row from zero.

questions.prompt: Which line sets the bottom-right cell to 9?
questions.hint: In a 2 by 2 grid, the last row and the last column both have index 1.

options.feedback: Row 1 and column 1 is the bottom-right cell.
Index 2 is past the end. The last index is 1.
Row 0 and column 1 is the top-right cell.
